CROSS REFERENCE.

SUBJECT:-

On 14.3.40 M.I.5 forwarded to S.I.S. a note on Wilhelm FRISCHAUER which had been made from the translation of a report forwarded by Karl GROEHL to Karl OTTEN. The report dealt mainly with FRISCHAUER's activities and connections in Austria.

Original in....1,169B.(173).41a.............dated.....14.3.40.............

S. Form 81.
